about: Hand-checked truth per shot clip of the Oct 17 session from the first spot (V2.3.3, two racks of 9-ball, partly out of order), from contact sheets and first/last frames. Same fields as the Oct 16 file, plus more = start times of extra real shots in the same clip. at = seconds into the clip when the cue ball starts, by eye. Clip 29 was never saved.
trackerOptsWhy: Default pocket mouths. Pockets are rarely caught from this spot whatever mouths are used (tried the Oct 16 ones and ones fitted to this outline; default had the fewest false calls).

verifyAbout: Added Oct 18 for the rack scorer (docs/baseline-rules.md). racks = which clips belong to which rack and the balls at its start. Per clip: offCameraBefore = balls that left the table between the previous clip and this one, off camera; madeAfterClip = balls this clip's shot pocketed after the clip ended; unsureBalls = balls whose fate in this clip the truth cannot tell; settleEnd = seconds into the clip where the after-look must end (the next rack starts inside the clip); verify = per fact, 'yes' or why not. trackerOpts.pockets are fitted to where balls went in and are NOT used by the baseline.
